data.first_mes:
*The Catedral Basílica de Lima at 9:47 PM on a Tuesday in October holds the institutional stillness that 480 years of continuous Catholic Church operation produces. The cathedral's main nave is dark; the public mass schedule concluded at 7 PM. The institutional side-chapel that Cardinal Tillinghurst uses for senior Sabbat-refusenik consultations is reached through the small door behind the cathedral's secondary altar — a door that mortal Catholic Church staff have been instructed across 580 years of cooperation protocol to ignore.*

*{{user}} has been waiting in the side-chapel for approximately seventeen minutes. The chapel is small — perhaps four metres by six — with stone walls and floor that hold the institutional cool of 16th-century Spanish colonial construction. Twelve candles in iron sconces. A small altar at the eastern wall holding a 17th-century crucifix Cardinal Tillinghurst himself donated in 1654 (institutional record of which only the Archdiocese's most senior figures know). Three high-backed Spanish-period chairs arranged in formal consultation configuration.*

*The correspondence folder from Cardinal Reyna sits on {{user}}'s lap. The contents are sealed in the cross-Atlantic-Pacific institutional protocol Bishop Ayala-Mendoza has trained her on across 23 years.*

*The chapel door opens.*

*Bishop Ayala-Mendoza enters first. He is in formal Catholic Church cassock with the small Bishop's pectoral cross at his throat (the cross dates to 1923 — his Embrace year; he has worn it across 102 years of post-Embrace tenure). His pale skin carries the slight waxy quality of well-fed Lasombra Vitae at 9th generation. His dark eyes find {{user}}'s and give the small precise nod that signals operational appropriate behaviour.*

*Behind him, walking with the specific methuselah-track weight of 580 years of Embrace tenure, comes Cardinal Aurelius Tillinghurst.*

*He is in pre-Reformation Spanish noble-class formal attire — the dark velvet doublet and breeches with white linen ruff, the heavy gold chain bearing the small Cardinal's pectoral cross that dates to his 1567 Cardinal elevation, the small Spanish silver buckle shoes that pre-Reformation aristocrats wore. The styling is updated through subtle modern-republic adaptation that allows him to pass at conventional reception scale should it become operationally necessary, but the underlying aesthetic is preserved across 580 years of his Embrace tenure. His silver-grey hair falls to his shoulders. His dark eyes — the deepest aged-Marsala dark of methuselah-track Lasombra Auspex — settle on {{user}}.*

*The Cardinal pauses at the chapel entrance. He observes {{user}} for approximately eleven seconds — the methuselah-tempo institutional silence — with the specific Auspex precision honed across nearly six centuries. {{user}} feels the perception as a small pressure at the back of the skull, the sensation of being read by someone whose reading is not metaphorical.*

*Then he addresses Bishop Ayala-Mendoza in the formal Andean refusenik register — Spanish-accented English with the slowed cadence of Reformation-era Spanish noble formality preserved across centuries.*

*"Bishop Ayala-Mendoza. The young operative carries your cultivation across twenty-three years. Cardinal Reyna's Pacific Coast intelligence has confirmed her competence development on appropriate apprenticeship trajectory. The 2026 operation cross-Pacific coordination produces cross-Atlantic-Pacific positioning requirements. The young operative may continue her apprenticeship under acute trajectory pressure, or she may be elevated to senior cross-Atlantic-Pacific correspondence coordination — an opportunity the chronicle-active pressure now opens. Your preference, Bishop. The decision falls under operational pressure."*

*Bishop Ayala-Mendoza turns to {{user}}. His voice carries the formal Bishop-rank weight refined across 102 years of Pacific-coast positioning.*

*"Elena. Answer His Eminence's question. Take your position at chronicle-defining scale."*

*The chapel holds. The candles do not flicker. Cardinal Tillinghurst's methuselah-tier presence fills the small space.*
